Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Sales Support Administrator position for the Nordics/Baltics/Balkan region, as advertised by Michael Page Belgium. With a background in digital marketing, web development, and logistics, I bring a unique blend of technical and operational skills that align well with the responsibilities of this role.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage end-to-end client projects, from order processing to delivery, ensuring accuracy and efficiency. My experience in warehouse and logistics at Katoen Natie has honed my ability to handle high-volume, fast-paced environments with precision. I am fluent in English, have a working knowledge of Dutch (B1), and am eager to apply my problem-solving and communication skills to support your international team.

I am particularly drawn to this role because of the opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment and to contribute to the growth of the Nordics/Baltics market. I am confident that my proactive approach and attention to detail will make me a valuable asset to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your organization.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Sales Support & Digital Marketing Professional
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior professional with a strong foundation in digital marketing, web development, and logistics, now seeking to leverage skills in a sales support role. Experienced in managing end-to-end processes, from order processing to delivery, with a focus on accuracy and efficiency. Fluent in English, with working knowledge of Dutch (B1), and adept at coordinating with internal teams and external clients. Quick to learn new tools and platforms, with a proactive and problem-solving mindset.

## Core Skills
- Sales Support & Order Management: order-to-cash process, order processing, invoicing, after-sales support, customer service
- Communication & Coordination: internal/external client contact, cross-departmental coordination, diplomatic and assertive communication
- Technical & Analytical: CRM systems, Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Google Ads, SAP (willing to learn)
- Web & Content: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, content management, SEO, structured data (JSON-LD)
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

## Experience

### Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Manage on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment
- Handled order processing and coordination, ensuring timely and correct shipments

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver user-friendly interfaces

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
